# ADR-3256: AWS security_groups: Self-referencing SG with all ports for tier 8

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

All-ports self refs defeat microsegmentation.

## Decision

Tiers SHALL NOT use a self-referencing SG with all ports for tier 8 (AWS-security_groups-8) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Allow only is expected to ports between peers.
